items.title: Should You Buy Uber Stock For Its Cash?
items.summary: Uber Technologies produced free cash flow equal to 8% of its market value at Monday's close. The median S&P 500 company stood at 4.4%. Free cash flow is the cash left from operations after spending on equipment and property. For Uber, it came to $10.4 billion in the twelve months to September.

items.title: DoorDash vs. Etsy: Which Consumer Favorite Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.summary: DoorDash's revenue is growing far faster than Etsy's, but the two stocks carry very different price tags, and that gap may matter more to your portfolio than the growth story.

items.title: Trump’s Labor Department Just Made It Easier to Treat Drivers as Contractors. That’s Good News for Uber
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Labor Department finalized a rule, effective in January, that makes it easier to classify workers as independent contractors. That lowers the federal risk that Uber (UBER:NYSE), DoorDash (DASH:NASDAQ), and Lyft (LYFT:NASDAQ) must treat drivers as employees, who can cost up to 30% more.

items.title: Can Dollar General Sustain Its 80% Delivery Sales Incrementality?
items.summary: Dollar General's delivery business boasts 80% sales incrementality, larger baskets and strong repeat orders. Can this momentum last as its delivery network matures?

items.title: DoorDash Shares Climb 6.39% After Securing $1.79 Billion Loan Facility for Instacart Acquisition
items.summary: DoorDash (NYSE:DASH) shares advanced 6. 39% after the food delivery company announced expanded financing arrangements to support its proposed $17 billion acquisition of Instacart (NASDAQ:CART).

items.title: DoorDash Just Dropped 11% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDoorDash shares fell 11% in a week, mostly in a sell-off that took the Nasdaq 100 down about as much. Its one piece of news was a report that the Justice Department will review its $17 billion Instacart deal.
